coverage.summary: Authored three worked examples covering the distinct assessed methods, with different values, separate prompts and solutions, phantom relation gutters and shared number-line templates. Solution prose and mathematics inherit the renderer’s blue; diagrams retain the standing palette. All fifteen assessments were read solely for method classification and remain unchanged. No existing examples or source gaps. Independent review and actual rendering verification remain for the coordinator.

examples.derivation: sqrt(8) = 2.828427124746… rounds to 2.83. It lies between 2 and 3, approximately 0.83 of that interval from 2. The diagram uses 16 mm per unit, so the rounded position is 2.83 × 16 = 45.28 mm, matching the marked point. This adapts the supplied calculator-approximation and number-line examples.

sqrt(3)/2 = 0.866025403784… rounds to 0.87. It lies between 0 and 1. The diagram uses 80 mm per unit, so the rounded position is 0.87 × 80 = 69.6 mm, matching the marked point. Evaluating the complete expression before rounding follows the supplied scaled-irrational guided practice.

-sqrt(11) = -3.316624790355… rounds to -3.32. It lies between -4 and -3, approximately 0.32 units left of -3. With -4 at coordinate 0 and 16 mm per unit, its rounded position is (-3.32 + 4) × 16 = 10.88 mm, matching the marked point. This adapts the supplied negative-irrational number-line guided practice.
